literal_meaning: এক স্রোতে বা একই সময়ে ধারণ করে
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি একাধারে সম্পাদক ও প্রকাশকের ভূমিকা পালন করছেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He is serving as both editor and publisher simultaneously.
Handling two tasks at the same time is difficult.
note: This is a standard adverbial expression in Bengali, derived from Sanskrit roots, commonly used in modern contexts.
